findings.source_passage: I jumped to my feet and glared at him. 'Like hell you are! I'm not going back there, and you're going to let those other-' My not-so-eloquent speech was interrupted by the twinkling of laughter.
findings.source_locator: paragraph after 'The lord bowed his head. I am sorry...'
findings.why_it_matters: The narrator's self-deprecating aside 'My not-so-eloquent speech' is a voice-establishing beat — the heroine's ironic self-awareness in mid-crisis is central to the chapter's comic register. The draft replaces it with neutral narration ('Laughter, bright as light on water, broke over my rant'), erasing the self-commentary.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the parenthetical self-commentary in close proximity to the interrupted outburst, e.g., keep a version of 'my not-so-eloquent speech was interrupted' rather than absorbing it into description.

findings.source_locator: End of paragraph 2, describing the town's festive lights
findings.why_it_matters: This blunt, wry three-word sentence is a register-defining beat — the narrator punctuates an atmospheric observation with deadpan editorial judgment, establishing the sardonic voice that runs through the escape sequence.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore or closely echo the flat editorial aside at the end of the description of town lights below.

findings.source_passage: my aim was-well, as reliable as ever
findings.source_locator: Paragraph describing the rock throw at the Dragon Lord
findings.why_it_matters: The em-dash self-correction ('well, as reliable as ever') is a characteristic voice tic — the narrator catching herself mid-sentence and substituting irony. The draft's 'My aim was true to form' conveys the same fact but flattens the spoken, self-interrupting rhythm.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the self-interrupting construction: 'my aim was — well, as reliable as ever' rather than the more polished paraphrase.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; two medium-severity voice flattenings (the narrator's self-deprecating aside and the 'whole place was madness' editorial beat) and one low-severity rhythm loss are present but insufficient individually or collectively to require regeneration.
